task.description:
Design the type system for the Expression DSL. DSL-04 requires exactly six value types: null, bool, int64, float64, string, timestamp. Produce a design artefact at src/design/expr-types.md covering:

1. Type representation (Zig type definitions for a tagged union Value type)
2. Literal syntax for each type (null literal, bool literals, integer literals, float literals, string literals, timestamp literals)
3. Parse-time rejection of unsupported types with structured error
4. How the Value type integrates with the existing AST in src/expr/ and the evaluate() signature
5. Round-trip guarantee: parse -> evaluate of a literal produces the same value

Read the existing src/expr/ module and src/design/expr.md for context before designing.
acceptance_criteria: All six types are covered with their literal forms
Rejection of unsupported types is addressed
Integration with existing AST and evaluator is described
Round-trip (parse literal -> evaluate -> same value) is addressed

result.summary: Designed type system for DSL-04: Zig Value tagged union, literal syntax for 5 types (timestamp via built-ins), parse-time rejection of unsupported types, integration with existing AST/evaluator, round-trip guarantee. Artefact at src/design/expr-types.md.
